name: Interactive Brokers
description: Your Interactive Brokers account in OpenTrader, through IB Gateway or TWS or by logging in directly (beta): balances, positions, orders and trading from the charts, and IBKR: chart symbols with the broker's own data (US stocks and funds, forex, futures).

settings.label: Connection
settings.help: Direct login (beta): the plugin logs in to Interactive Brokers itself, no IB Gateway or TWS needed. Its login engine is still in beta: if something goes wrong, use IB Gateway or TWS and report it. The broker allows one session per username: TWS, IB Gateway or the mobile app logged in with the same username lose their market data meanwhile.

settings.label: Host
settings.help: The computer IB Gateway or TWS runs on. Keep 127.0.0.1 when it runs on this computer.

settings.label: Port
settings.help: The socket port set in the API settings of IB Gateway or TWS.

settings.label: Password
settings.help: Kept in your computer's credential store.

settings.label: Account
settings.help: Use the username of your paper trading account for Paper trading.

settings.label: Login approval
settings.help: How you confirm a live login: approve it in IBKR Mobile, or type the code OpenTrader asks for (security code card, authenticator, code sent by text). After a login, the plugin keeps a restart token in its data folder: the daily reconnection and the next starts need neither the password nor the approval for a few days.

settings.label: Login server
settings.help: Keep the default: the broker sends the login on to your account's server.

settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: Any number another API program connected to the same account does not use. Orders keep it: change it and the orders placed before can no longer be changed from OpenTrader.
